text:
ashwin: quick flag — noticed vault transit unwraps in europe-west1 around 11:09 UTC are present in Vault audit but I can't find matching KMS audit log entries. small set (~8) of unwraps missing from our KMS export.

maria: that's concerning. can you paste one sample from vault audit?

ashwin: redacted sample:
```
vault audit: 2026-07-10T11:09:12Z transit/unwrap id=cty-9d1f europe-west1 key=wrap-key v=5
```
query I ran: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=\"kms_crypto_key\" protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricDecrypt\" timestamp>\"2026-07-10T11:00:00Z\"" --project=ai-prod` — returned only other regions, not europe-west1.

tanvi: preliminary check: forwarder shows a reconnect around 11:08-11:10 and a small skip on partition 4. probably a forwarding pipeline gap, not IAM.

sre-bot: deploy event: audit-forwarder v2.9.3 rolled at 2026-07-10T10:50:00Z.

auditor-bot: snapshot gs://redwood-audit-backups/2026-07-10/4098765432-snap.json created.

maria: can we replay the missing offsets? sec-oncall, can you pull forwarder offsets and attempt rehydrate?

sec-oncall: running `kubectl -n infra exec audit-forwarder-0 -- /bin/forwarder admin offsets --region=europe-west1` now.

ashwin: replayed ~6/8 events successfully. 2 failed with `decode failed: unexpected padding` — likely partner payloads using nonstandard base64 padding.

tanvi: mapping those 2 ciphertext ids -> I get one metrics secret and one partner-ingest API key. partner-ingest is high-sensitivity.

maria: plan: 1) notify partner owners and rotate their API key immediately, 2) create new key version v6 for wrap-key in europe-west1, 3) rewrap ciphertexts with creation timestamp inside gap window, prioritizing high-sensitivity ones, 4) file infra follow-up to add retry queue and stricter decode validation.

sec-oncall: agree. I'll authorize readonly mode for vault-transit-eu for up to 30m if owners request it.

auditor-bot: ticket SEC-5902 created, label=needs-owner-notify, follow-up 2026-07-10T12:00:00Z.

ashwin: dry-run rewrap for partner ciphertext succeeded against newly created v6 alias. executing rotation for partner key now.

tanvi: owner DMed and confirmed rotation underway — they rotated client secret and will confirm rotation in 10m.

maria: please add INFRA-3412 for forwarder: add replay-retry + log raw payloads for failed decodes (scrubbed) so we can analyze partner encoders.

sre-bot: monitor set: audit-forwarder error rate >5/min will page oncall.

sec-oncall: recap actions:
- tanvi: owner notify + confirm partner rotation.
- ashwin: run targeted rewrap for gap window (high-sensitivity first).
- maria: file INFRA-3412 and schedule postmortem if gaps >5s recur.
- infra: improve forwarder decode handling + retry queue.

ashwin: will post rewrap results per-secret in follow-up. keeping this channel for short updates only.

(END)
